query.intent: The wallpaper should feel red; hue must be more similar to the requested color to count.

interpretationFlags: The #FF0000 query is inferred from the ongoing red-query conversation, not explicitly restated in the latest feedback. No amount target is inferred.
The initial phrase about hue influencing slightly less is superseded by the explicit clarification: hue has to be more similar to count.

The inline attachment reference order and first/second wording are ambiguous. The preference is resolved by the user descriptions most red versus orange and verified image content, not by inline attachment position.
The images were selected from ranked search results; this is not blind or independent validation. Exact UI settings for the reported ranks were not supplied.

review.presentation: Two images attached by the user after trying the existing prototype. Method controls and search ranks were available; presentation was not randomized.
review.selection: User selected perceived ranking failures from existing search results.
review.relevanceScope: One explicit relative preference. No numerical relevance grades, score gap, required final rank, or absolute acceptability labels were provided.

identification.method: Every real corpus thumbnail compared at auto-oriented sRGB64x64 fill RGB, followed by original-source verification. Errors use byte-valued RGB, 0..255.
